result.chapter_title: Smart Money Concepts, Order Blocks & Liquidity
result.section_title: Break of Structure (BOS) vs Change of Character (CHoCH)
result.content:
Market structure represents the directional footprint of institutional capital:
        - Uptrend: A sequence of Higher Highs (HH) and Higher Lows (HL).
        - Break of Structure (BOS): When price closes beyond the preceding swing high in an uptrend, confirming continuation of institutional accumulation.
        - Change of Character (CHoCH): When price violates and closes below the last Higher Low in an uptrend (or above the last Lower High in a downtrend). CHoCH is the earliest structural warning of trend reversal, signaling that institutional sponsors have paused absorption and are distributing.

rules.text: Add to trend continuation positions only on verified BOS candle body closes.
Immediately revoke active long mandates or tighten stops to breakeven upon hourly CHoCH.

result.section_title: Bull Flag and Bear Flag Continuations
result.content:
Flags are short-term continuation patterns that represent a brief pause in a dynamic trend:
        - Bull Flag: Consists of an almost vertical price rally (the Flagpole) driven by high volume and institutional momentum, followed by a compact downward-sloping or horizontal parallel channel (the Flag). The counter-trend consolidation must show a sharp drop in trading volume, indicating lack of selling interest. The flag consolidation should retrace no more than 38.2% to 50% of the flagpole height.
        - Bear Flag: Consists of an aggressive vertical selloff (Flagpole) on heavy volume, followed by a tight upward-sloping consolidation channel on light volume.
        - Measuring Target Formula: The expected target is a move equal to the height of the Flagpole (F) projected from the breakout level: Bull Flag Target = Breakout Price + F; Bear Flag Target = Breakdown Price - F.
        - Protective Stop: Position Stop-Loss just below the lowest point of the flag consolidation channel or 1.2x ATR below entry.

rules.text: Enter immediately on an hourly close outside the flag boundary in the direction of the flagpole.
Take-Profit target is the full Flagpole height added to the breakout price.
Stop-Loss is positioned 1.0x ATR below the lowest swing low inside the flag channel.
